notes: Open Valley is the publisher. HUUSD is the school district, and district enrollment counts refer to HUUSD. The district's school directory and community overview identify Duxbury, Fayston, Moretown, Waitsfield, Warren and Waterbury.

The directory lists seven schools/campuses but eight K–12 enrollment groups because Harwood middle and high share one school identity and campus. Adding a combined Harwood total to its middle- and high-school counts would count the same students twice.

Current facts describe 2026–27 as checked October 4, 2026; this is the verification date, not the date on which a configuration took effect. Historical counts retain the grades and definitions used by their sources. PK is separate. The current three-hub arrangement does not establish which PK programs Fayston and Waitsfield had in earlier years.

Current enrollment figures come from the September 2026 preliminary snapshot. Its exact count day and treatment of Early College have not been verified. The latest October attending figures are from October 1, 2025. Each set is identified by its own date and status because these are different series, not interchangeable current totals.

Undated enrollment figures from website marketing were not used. Annual counts reported as observations are labeled observed because final certification has not been established. Observed does not mean certified final.

Pathways describe the usual structure, not guaranteed individual assignment. K–8 applications are subject to capacity and procedures. No attendance zones, nearest-school assignments or transportation guarantees are inferred.

Campus points use the state layer's returned geometry rounded to five decimals. They are general-reference locations, not surveyed entrances. Warren's older address discrepancy was resolved with the E911 source without moving its marker.
These are reviewed candidate inputs. Catalog additions, host validation and the publication lifecycle are required before runtime use. No app or database release is implied by this file.
